text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Live streaming endpoint /v1/stream is breaching latency SLOs. p95 ~ 420ms (SLO 200ms), p99 ~ 1.6s. Detected increased tail stalls and >15% streaming fragment timeouts in the last 10m. Prefix cache hitrate dropped from 92% -> 34% across edge-batch-01/02.

oncall-jess: seeing it too. Grafana: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/streaming/live-latency — p99 spike aligns with a prefix-hash rollout at ~1719503800.

eng-sre-raj: confirmed correlation with prefix-hash v2 roll: rollout started earlier, batch multiplier changed, looks like new hash mapping causing many cold miss routes to different shards. Low hit rate -> more paging -> tail stalls.

platform-ana: can we throttle the rollout or flip to v1? Current rollout policy is 10% step with 5m windows; looks like new mapping flipped ~48% of traffic in region-us-east.

oncall-jess: support-customer impact check: are user-facing requests failing or just slower?

support-luis: some customers reporting degraded streaming quality (stutters every 2-3s). No hard errors, but timeouts for fragment fetches up. Ticket #INC-4312 opened by customer X. Communicating that we're investigating.

eng-sre-raj: immediate plan: 1) Pause/rollback prefix-hash v2 -> v1 2) Trigger cache warmup on affected shards 3) Temporarily route traffic away from hot edge shards to warm ones 4) Keep prefetch aggressive until hit rate stabilizes.

platform-ana: I'll hold the rollout. Command:
```bash
# rollback rollout flag
redwoodctl rollout set-prefix-hash --env=prod --version=v1 --force
```

oncall-jess: Raj — can you run a quick probe to confirm the mapping mismatch? Maybe dump prefix distribution counts.

eng-sre-raj: running probe now. snippet of counts:
```text
edge-batch-01: hashes_received=312k unique_prefixes=298k cache_hits=104k cache_misses=194k
edge-batch-02: hashes_received=287k unique_prefixes=276k cache_hits=96k cache_misses=180k
expected hitrate ~90% but observed ~34% across these nodes
```

eng-sre-raj: looks like salting change in v2. Old salt produced stable locality; v2 changed namespace salt param. Many prefixes got remapped -> caches cold.

platform-ana: rollback triggered. Wait for config propagation (estimate 20-40s). I'll post when rollout reverts.

incident-bot: ACTION: Rollback initiated by platform-ana at 1719504505.

oncall-jess: while rollback propagates, let's mitigate tail: 1) increase streaming prefetch window to 3 (was 1), 2) bump in-memory cache TTL on edge nodes to 90s (was 30s), 3) disable aggressive eviction for 10m. Raj, can you push those?

eng-sre-raj: applying prefetch and TTL overrides via runtime flags:
```bash
# increase prefetch
redwoodctl config set --path=runtime.streaming.prefetch_window --value=3 --env=prod
# bump ttl
redwoodctl config set --path=cache.edge.ttl_sec --value=90 --env=prod
```
applied to edge-batch-01/02/03. Monitoring hitrate.

support-luis: letting affected customers know we're rolling back prefix-hash and applying mitigations. Draft message: "We're rolling back a recent routing change and applying cache warmup and prefetch to reduce streaming stutters. Expect improvement in ~2-5 minutes." Want approval to send?

cs-maya: approve send. include ETA and note no data loss. Keep them in status channel.

eng-sre-raj: initial metrics 90s after rollback: p95 down to 190ms, p99 down to 320ms, streaming fragment timeouts reduced to baseline. Edge hitrate climbed to ~88% on edges where warmup ran. Still watching a couple of hotspots.

noncall-jess: good. Raj — can you run a targeted KVsync on the two shards with lingering low hitrate? Might be cold LRU.

eng-sre-raj: running kvsync on shard ids 221, 223:
```bash
# fast kv sync
redwoodctl kvsync start --shard=221,223 --mode=incremental --env=prod
```
Sync completed in 2m, verified prefix index counts reconciled.

platform-ana: rollback fully propagated at 1719504683. Verified rollout state: v1 at 100% for prefix-hash.

incident-bot: NOTE: SLO above normal again. p95 now 150-210ms, p99 280-350ms. Closing immediate mitigation but keep flags for 30m.

support-luis: updated customers at 1719504750: "Mitigation in place, performance improving; continuing to monitor." No escalations so far.

cs-maya: created follow-up CS thread for affected customers, scheduling a post-incident call if they want a deep-dive.

noncall-jess: postmortem TODOs: - root cause: prefix-hash v2 introduced salt param change without staged hash-mapping validation - add canary test that verifies prefix mapping locality before rollout - extend rollout guard to detect >10% drop in cache hitrate and auto-halt - improve pre-deploy QA: replay small sample of live prefixes through new hash to measure remap fraction

eng-sre-raj: I'll open RFC for canary validation and add a runtime check (shard-locality delta). Also propose a lightweight simulation harness `prefix-rollout-sim` to estimate remap ratio before rollout.

platform-ana: follow-up ops: add a temporary preflight that runs on 1% traffic and compares mapping overlap metric. If overlap <85% -> auto-halt.

noncall-jess: handing off to eng-sre for after-action and pairing with platform-ana on rollout gating. Oncall duties: 30m watch, escalate if p99 > 500ms.

eng-sre-raj: Ack. Will draft postmortem and PRs.

support-luis: closing customer ticket as "monitoring". We'll re-open if they report anything.

cs-maya: recording timeline for customer notes.

incident-bot: HANDOFF: oncall-jess -> eng-sre-raj at 1719506723.

oncall-jess: thanks team. I'll remain reachable for 30m. :thumbsup:
